annotation.title_clean: MinCiencias lidera el Proyecto de Ley que busca regular el desarrollo ético, seguro y responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial en Colombia
annotation.title_en: MinCiencias leads the Bill seeking to regulate the ethical, safe and responsible development of Artificial Intelligence in Colombia
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (MinCiencias), Colombia
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Colombian Ministry of Science press release (7 May 2025) announcing the filing, with MinTIC, of an AI bill in Congress. The bill takes a risk-based approach (prohibited, high, limited, minimal), designates MinCiencias as the National AI Authority, creates an advisory council and includes labour-transition and innovation measures. It is aligned with CONPES 4144, the OECD, UNESCO and the EU approach.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill classifies AI systems into prohibited, high, limited and minimal risk tiers
MinCiencias designated as National Authority for AI; National AI Advisory Council created
Rules protecting privacy, non-discrimination and human dignity
Measures for labour transition, talent training and research incentives
Claimed as first Latin American bill with ethical, democratic and sovereign AI regulation, aligned with CONPES 4144
